rebuttal_response: The proposed P02S “clarification” does not resolve P00A-B02. Criterion 4 expressly requires P02S to own all structured-file edits and requires that no other prompt own structured transformation units. Checkpoint v2 instead confirms that downstream prompts own and apply the live structured-file mutations. That is the opposite of the pass condition, regardless of whether they use P02S-provided tooling.

findings.title: Resolved manifest still does not contain the required 13 activated prompts
findings.criterion_ref: Criterion 2: “Resolved manifest exists, contains exactly 13 activated prompts (P00, P00A, P01–P10)” and its prescribed manifest path `prompt_manifest.resolved.v1.yaml`.
findings.trigger: The checkpoint manifest is checked or used to dispatch downstream prompts.
findings.consequence: The required v1 manifest is absent from its prescribed active path, and the replacement v2 manifest leaves P01–P10/P02S marked `template_requires_resolution`; therefore it does not provide the required 13 activated prompts.
findings.evidence: `plans_internal/refactor_repo/prompts/resolved/prompt_manifest.resolved.v1.yaml` does not exist. The replacement `prompt_manifest.resolved.v2.yaml` corrects the filenames but marks only P00 `completed` and P00A `active`; all eleven downstream entries are `template_requires_resolution`.

findings.title: P02S still does not own all live structured-file edits
findings.criterion_ref: Criterion 4 pass condition: “P02S owns all structured file edits,” with verification that “no other prompt owns structured-file transformation units.”
findings.trigger: A downstream prompt applies a TOML, JSON, or YAML edit to a live repository file.
findings.consequence: Structured-file mutation ownership resides outside P02S, so the mandated exclusive ownership and independent codemod gate cannot pass.
findings.evidence: Checkpoint v2 states: “P02S does not own the application of edits to live files” and “Downstream prompts own the actual structured-file mutations in their file domains.” The P02S prompt likewise says downstream owners apply the codemod.

observations: The eight incorrect prompt filenames from round 1 were corrected in manifest v2; that portion of P00A-B01 is repaired.
P00 evidence hashes remain consistent, the P00A prompt validates successfully, and current untracked changes remain under the authorized planning paths.
The broad rollback command and confusing 22/24/26 mutation-unit accounting noted in round 1 remain non-blocking observations.
reasoning: The round history accurately records my one prior verdict and its two findings. I independently checked checkpoint v2, the replacement manifest, repository status, artifact digest, and schema validation.
